I checked every starting condition: NPC survival (N/A), injury (none), items (watch, phone), relationships (neglected son), location (mansion), and abilities (future memories). All checks passed. Asset change (from personal assets to 19.7 billion in a corporate account), inventory change (adding a corporate seal, new phone, laptop, losing personal assets), injury status change (mental confusion to focused fatigue), and location change (mansion to officetel). **Pacing Suitability**. Does the flow feel right? Five episodes to establish the protagonist, his goal, his resources, and the initial setup? It’s a reasonable length, neither rushed nor dragging. It feels just right.
